geometry_edits.rationale: Reorient the stepped mass so the hierarchy becomes more legible from the frontage and the open edge can develop at ground level.
Reduce the code-like terrace repetition slightly and keep the cascade coherent as one continuous stepped body.
Open the base a bit more to support a clearer public threshold without replacing the dominant mass.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent early-stage mass with a clear stepped dominant idea and acceptable overall hierarchy. It reads consistently across all four views, so it clears the one-view-only failure gate and there is no obvious inter-view collision. The main weakness is programmatic: for neighborhood living, the mass currently behaves more like a compact stepped object than a neighborhood building with a strong public ground condition. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; the form does not open a legible court, seam, or entry void toward that edge, so void_publicness is limited. Still, the silhouette is not arbitrary: the stepped section is continuous and repairable, and the massing has some resonance with the reference set, especially the terrace/community-center precedents. Because the program does not require a long-span roof section, this does not fail program-fit hard pass, but it remains below ideal and should be improved by carving a clearer public threshold and aligning the open side to access.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is much more compact and stair-stepped; it lacks the pronounced central opening and connective void of the reference.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Crisp low-rise massing with a large carved void and bridge-like upper connection can create an active neighborhood threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is far more distributed and open than the candidate; copying its overall campus scale would be inappropriate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A campus-like composition can still support neighborhood living when the masses organize around a clear public center.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate does not have the same planar spread or transparent perimeter condition.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A long horizontal mass with a readable courtyard/atrium and roof articulation can support mixed neighborhood uses.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate reads more like a compact stepped block than a terrain-like ribbon or linear promenade.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, landscape-like stepping can work when it frames public space and maintains a strong continuous section.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is less porous and the interlock is weaker; its massing remains mostly one stepped object.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking volumes and a central void can maintain hierarchy while giving the ground floor a public role.

warnings: The ground edge response is underdeveloped relative to the verified access edge.
The stepped form is coherent, but it still reads as a compact mass rather than a neighborhood threshold.
No clear public court/void is present in the current massing.
